# marketing-plan

A 12-month marketing plan of the kind a fractional CMO would hand a founder.

## When to use

A real planning session — not a quick question. Budget onwards: who the customer is, what has been
tried, what is stuck, what the team can actually execute.

## How it runs — three phases, not one shot

1. **Intake** — reads whatever exists about the business, interviews you, scores the current state
   against a 17-section rubric (0-5 each).
2. **Section-by-section review** — walks all 13 sections one at a time: approve, adjust, expand.
   Resumable; stop today, continue tomorrow.
3. **Compile** — one document, cross-references verified.

## What's inside

Everything is tagged by funnel stage (acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue), so the
plan comes out in priority order rather than as a wish list. A **139-tactic library** ships inside the
skill; section 12 marks each one now / next quarter / later / skip for your case. Also a 90-day
week-by-week roadmap, quarterly outlook, metrics and open decisions.

## Caveats

Largest skill here — 255 KB across 15 reference files. Assumes a funded startup (there is a whole
reference on what unlocks at which funding stage); for consulting or info-products, parts miss.
By default it writes to `~/marketing-plans/<client>/` — repoint that if it is not where you want files.
